summary: Window title setting is implemented, with no tests run and nothing committed. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(); rich/_windows_renderer.py calls term.set_title(title) for the new type; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (console, skipped on Windows), test_control_title, and test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only, mocked wrapper). Black-style line length was checked by reading only.
